Standard per-model monitors - After a week of firing data: delete the hand-written monitors the generic set covers - Move generic routes from #inference-alerts-testing to #inference-alerts - Default (decision): page only on failed customer calls and GPU hardware faults; rest to Slack - Coverage per prod model - R-1, R-1 mini, Magpie, Maverick, Triton: failed calls, latency, capacity, GPU health; one panel + one alert each, small PRs per area - Uniform tags, then one dashboard - model_role / model_version on model.call spans - Model dropdown on the Terraform "Reducto Inference" dashboard; drop duplicate dashboards - Default (decision): inference-health site for daily health and COGS, Datadog for live triage - GPU hardware signals and logs - use1 / uss1 to the dcgm-exporter chart (XID) - GCP container logs: failed requests only (default, decision) - Weekly check of active downtimes and unactioned alerts → #inference-alerts-testing # Logs -
